eventDetail.scope: EMC² 2027 is a premier research-oriented conference dedicated to advancements in embedded systems, mobile communication, and computing. With a strong emphasis on academic excellence and industrial innovation, it aspires to serve as a leading platform for global scholarly exchange. The conference will convene distinguished experts, researchers, engineers, and industry leaders from around the world to address emerging opportunities and challenges in cutting-edge domains such as embedded architectures, mobile communication technologies, and intelligent computing systems. By fostering interdisciplinary dialogue and collaboration, EMC² 2027 aims to accelerate research breakthroughs, drive practical applications, advance disciplinary development, and nurture the next generation of talent.
